name: ETOPO 2022 v1 ice-surface / seafloor relief
encoding: signed 16-bit little-endian metres; rows south to north, columns west to east

sourceSubset.method: One central source cell from each 9×9 block; point decimation, not a block mean.

citation: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information (2022), ETOPO 2022 15 Arc-Second Global Relief Model
terms: Freely available for private, academic and commercial uses; retain source citation.
limitations: Static composite elevation model, not current terrain, tide or a survey at every cell.
The 60-arc-second source is itself downsampled from ETOPO 2022 15-arc-second grids.
The application retains central 9-arc-minute samples and rounds display elevations to the nearest metre; smaller islands, peaks and trenches may be missed.
EGM2008 heights are rendered radially on a mean-radius sphere, not converted to WGS84 ellipsoid heights.
Ice-surface variant: Greenland and Antarctic ice heights are shown, not sub-ice bedrock.
